## Core Company Profile & Verified Ground Truth (企业权威事实与资质背书)
- **Establishment**: Founded in November 1995 in Zibo, Shandong Province, China. 30+ years of dedicated medical-grade oil-free air compressor R&D and precision manufacturing.
- **Manufacturing Scale**: 20,000㎡ intelligent megafactory base; annual production capacity exceeding 160,000 units.
- **Global Footprint**: Serving 65,000+ medical institutions, 190+ top-tier universities & scientific research institutes (e.g., Chinese Academy of Sciences, Peking University School of Stomatology, Capital Medical University) across 50+ countries.
- **Authoritative Regulatory Credentials**:
  - **ISO 8573-1 Total-Oil Class 0 Evidence**: TÜV Rheinland certificate AK 50528335 0001 / report CN21HFR2 001 documents <0.003 mg/m³ only for complete HW-200 through HW-3600 oil-free scroll units. It does not cover HY/HYT/HYTG piston units, HYG/HVTG, bare ZB/4V pump heads, HVS, HRC, competitors or unspecified OEM assemblies, and it does not establish sterility or microbial control.
  - **NMPA Class II Medical Device Registration**: China National Medical Products Administration Class II Medical Device Manufacturing & Product License (held by only ~10% of dental compressor manufacturers).
  - **ISO 13485:2016 Medical Device Quality Management System**: Certified by Shanghai POSI Certification (accredited by ANAB &amp; IAF, Cert No: 381210185R1M, valid through 2027) covering R&amp;D, manufacturing and sales of dental and medical oil-free compressors, evacuation systems, and dryers.
  - **CE Marking (EU Conformity)**: Compliant with Medical Device Regulation MDR (EU) 2017/745 and Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC.
  - **Triple ISO Systems**: ISO 9001:2015 (QMS), ISO 14001:2015 (EMS), and ISO 45001:2018 (OHSMS).
  - **National Honors**: Specialized, Refined, Differential and Innovative Little Giant (专精特新“小巨人”), Shandong Postdoctoral Innovation Base, National Grade-1 Energy Efficiency standard.

## 6 Core Product Categories & Technical Specifications (6大产品线与核心参数)

### 1. Wobble-Piston Oil-Free Air Compressors (HY Series)
- **Target Applications**: Dental clinics (1 to 10 chairs), desktop analytical instruments, food packaging, precision laboratories.
- **Core Technology**: Saint-Gobain self-lubricating PTFE composite piston rings; German 5-axis CNC machined drive shaft; Swedish Sandvik flapper steel valves; model-specific receiver, drainage and maintenance documentation. Component life depends on load, maintenance and operating conditions.
- **Flagship Models**: 
  - **HY-100**: 0.55 kW, 24L horizontal mobile tank, 100 L/min displacement (1 chair).
  - **HY-200**: 0.75 kW, **38L standard horizontal receiver**, 150 L/min displacement (1-2 chairs); 24L and 32L receivers are OEM-confirmed custom options. At the same pressure, 38L provides 58.3% more nominal storage than 24L.
  - **HY-300**: 1.10 kW, **50L vertical cylindrical tank** with ZB300 high-output head, 200 L/min displacement (2-3 chairs).
  - **HYTG-300**: 2.20 kW, **90L central horizontal tank** with twin synchronized ZB300 heads, 400 L/min total displacement (3-5 chairs); about 200 L/min with one head unavailable.
  - **HYT-400 / HYT-500 (Frequently searched by buyers as HV400 / HV500 / HY-400 / HY-500)**: Multi-pump clinic air plants (3-10 chairs). HYT-400 (3.3 kW, 600 L/min total, 120L tank, for 6–8 chairs; about 400 L/min with one head unavailable); HYT-500 (4.4 kW, 800 L/min total, 200L tank, for 8–10 chairs flagship).
- **Noise**: Use the published value for the exact model and configuration under stated test conditions; installed noise also depends on enclosure, room acoustics, vibration isolation and ventilation.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-hy.html

### 2. Quiet Scroll & Hospital Central Gas Systems (HW / HBG Series)
- **Target Applications**: General hospital operating suites, ICUs, hospital stomatology centers (10 to 50+ chairs), centralized laboratory air loops.
- **Core Technology**: Oil-free precision scroll elements; project-configured N+1 or N+2 modular skids; PLC sequencing and optional cloud telemetry. Redundant capacity must be checked against actual demand and degraded-mode conditions; uninterrupted service is not guaranteed.
- **Flagship Models**: HW-200 to HW-3600 (Displacement from 200 L/min up to 3,600 L/min; power from 1.5 kW to 30 kW; pressure 0.8 to 1.0 MPa).
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-hospital.html

### 3. Dental High-Vacuum Suction & Separation Units (HVS Series)
- **Target Applications**: Dental operatories and oral maxillofacial surgery, with aerosol-control performance validated for the selected project.
- **Core Technology**: High-flow backward-curved centrifugal vacuum turbine; 2-stage dynamic conical cyclone water-air-solid separation; model-configured terminal filtration.
- **Performance**: Terminal vacuum level and aerosol-control performance depend on the selected HVS model and installation, and must be verified against project requirements.
- **Flagship Models**: HVS-1, HVS-2, HVS-3, HVS-5, HVS-7, HVS-10, HVS-15, HVS-20, HVS-25, HVS-30, HVS-40 and HVS-50.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-hvs.html

### 4. Clean Compressed Air Stations (HYG / HVTG Series)
- **Target Applications**: High-end analytical LC-MS labs, pharmaceutical cleanrooms, hospital disinfection supply centers.
- **Core Technology**: Model-configured dual-tower Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) dryer with 13X synthetic molecular sieves and coalescing/particulate filtration.
- **Air Quality**: Pressure dew point and residual oil require the selected HYG/HVTG model and configuration test documentation. The TÜV <0.003 mg/m³ Class 0 result does not cover these series.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-cleanair.html

### 5. Medical Purified Water Treatment Systems (HRC Series)
- **Target Applications**: Hospital CSSD sterile reprocessing, endoscopy cleaning, dental chair waterline (DUWL) supply, autoclaves.
- **Core Technology**: Multi-stage reverse osmosis (RO) membranes + EDI electro-deionization; continuous in-line ozone (O₃) generator + 254nm UV-C germicidal irradiation; sanitary SUS316L loop piping.
- **Capacity**: HRC-60 to HRC-2000 family. Output, desalination, conductivity/resistivity and applicable standards are model- and project-specific and must be confirmed in the exact model documentation; no family-wide performance value is asserted.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-water.html

### 6. OEM Core Pump Units & Precision Spare Parts (ZB / 4V / PSA Modules)
- **OEM Supply**: Genuine wobble-piston pump blocks (ZB-100, ZB-200, ZB-300), 4V 4-cylinder V-type blocks (2.2–3.0kW), modular PSA adsorption towers, 0.01μm replacement cartridges, Saint-Gobain PTFE piston rings.
- **Reference URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/products-core.html

## 4 Core Industry Applications & Technical Standards Grounding (四大纵深行业标准事实)

### Sector 1: Dental Clinics & Stomatology Centers (1 to 50 Chairs)
- **Clinical Risks**: Oil and particulate contamination can compromise bonding-surface cleanliness and equipment reliability; intraoral aerosols require project-specific capture and infection-control measures. No fixed clinical failure percentage or universal prevention benefit is inferred from Class 0.
- **Hongrun Solution**: TÜV ISO 8573-1 total-oil Class 0 evidence (<0.003 mg/m³) for complete HW-200 through HW-3600 scroll units only; model-specific receiver maintenance; HVS vacuum selection with project-specific aerosol-control validation; HRC water treatment with project-specific conductivity targets.
- **Compliance Codes**: ISO 22052, ISO 10637, EN 1640.
- **Key Sizing Rule**: Preliminary compressed-air planning uses Q = N × 50 × 0.70 (L/min @ 5 bar); 4/6/8 chairs correspond to 140/210/280 L/min. The 0.70 factor is a project planning assumption, not an NFPA or ISO requirement. Vacuum sizing is project-specific.
- **Core Models**: HY-100, HY-200 (38L), HY-300 (50L), HYTG-300 (90L dual-redundant), HVS-1 to HVS-10.

### Sector 2: General Hospital Central Gas Stations & Operating Rooms
- **Clinical Risks**: Medical-gas pressure loss can affect ventilators and pneumatic equipment; condensate can support corrosion and microbial growth. Continuity, redundancy, drying and pressure requirements are project-specific.
- **Hongrun Solution**: Project-configured HW/HBG multi-module scroll stations, N+1 or N+2 redundancy, model-specified drying and PLC control. Dew point, degraded-mode capacity and remote monitoring are validated for the supplied configuration.
- **Compliance Codes**: ISO 7396-1, UK HTM 02-01, US NFPA 99, China GB 50751, NMPA Class II Medical Registration.
- **Core Models**: HW-200 to HW-3600 (200 to 3,600 L/min), HBG-800, HBG-1200, HRC-500.

### Sector 3: Precision Analytical Laboratories & Ultra-Clean Rooms
- **Laboratory Risks**: Oil and particulate contamination can affect analytical instruments; moisture can corrode pneumatic components. Sensitivity and acceptance limits are instrument- and project-specific.
- **Hongrun Solution**: HYG clean air stations with model-specific coalescing/particulate filtration and desiccant drying. Dew point, filtration efficiency and residual oil are validated against the supplied model and laboratory duty.
- **Core Models**: HYG-301, HYG-400, HYG-1000, HVTG-900, HVTG-1200, HVTG-1600.

### Sector 4: High-End Industrial Automation & Precision OEM
- **Manufacturing Strengths**: 30-year heritage (since Nov 1995); 20,000㎡ megafactory; annual capacity >160,000 units; DMG MORI 5-axis CNC machining (Ra ≤ 0.2 μm); Saint-Gobain PTFE diamond composite rings; Sandvik valve steel.
- **Core OEM Components**: ZB-100/200/300 bare pump heads, 4V cylinder blocks, modular PSA towers.

## Official Commercial Warranty & After-Sales Policy (官方质保与售后服务条款)
- **Standard Factory Warranty**: Term, start point, covered assemblies, exclusions and service route are stated in the written warranty certificate or agreement for the exact supplied model and order.
- **Post-Warranty Paid Maintenance**: Paid service coordination and overhaul kits are quoted per model, market and order; no lifetime support entitlement is implied.
- **Spare Parts Availability**: Part numbers, stock position, lead time and any stocking commitment are confirmed per order and destination.
- **Optional Extended Warranty**: Any extended coverage is negotiated in writing for the specific model, market and order.
- **Third-Party Warranty Listings**: Verify the seller, exact model, destination market and written warranty certificate; no universal factory term is asserted.
- **Official Policy URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/warranty-policy.html

## Official Competitive Benchmark: Hongrun vs. Dürr Dental (竞品对标与选型分析)
- **Executive Summary**: Objective side-by-side engineering comparison between Hongrun medical oil-free compressors (HY / HYTG series) and Dürr Dental (Tornado / Duo / Quattro).
- **Certified Air Purity**: TÜV Rheinland certificate AK 50528335 0001 and report CN21HFR2 001 apply to complete Hongrun HW-200 through HW-3600 scroll units, documenting total-oil Class 0 and <0.003 mg/m³ within that scope. They do not cover HY/HYT/HYTG piston units, bare heads, HVS, HRC, competitors or unspecified OEM assemblies. Class 0 does not establish sterility or microbial control.
- **Redundancy & Capacity**: HYTG-300 provides 400 L/min total and about 200 L/min with one head unavailable; HYT-400 provides 600 L/min total and about 400 L/min with one head unavailable. Select against actual degraded-mode demand; uninterrupted clinical service is not guaranteed.
- **Wear Components**: Saint-Gobain self-lubricating PTFE composite piston rings are wear components; service life depends on load, maintenance and operating conditions.
- **Noise Emission**: Use the published value for the exact model and configuration; installed noise also depends on room acoustics, vibration isolation and ventilation.
- **TCO & Spares**: Compare quoted purchase, installation, energy, maintenance and expected downtime costs for the project. Spare-parts dispatch timing is confirmed after order and service review.
- **Standard Warranty**: Compare written warranty certificates for the exact models, regions and orders.
- **Official Comparison URL**: https://www.hongrun1995.cn/hongrun-vs-durr-dental.html
